sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Life - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You came here for the money, right? Don't even try to deny it! Like I'm in any position to judge that, ha. If you want real cash, you need a real name. Fighting as part of a team is fine, but the only way to make it to the top is on your own! In fights where it's every man for himself, that's where skill really shows."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 15 enemies in Last Hero mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +2,100 EXP
- 22,000 Roubles
- 9 GP coins
- Unlocks Diamond Age NeoSteel High Cut helmet (Black) in the Armory
- Unlocks Kalashnikov AKMSN 7.62x39 assault rifle in the Armory
- Unlocks ANA Tactical M2 plate carrier (OD Green) in the Armory
